basis: Frozen E6 v2 DynamicReal and DynamicShuffled implementation
independent_unit: held-out battery product; five affected products
state_convention: post-current; operation t is applied before ranking future candidates with t+1 as reference positive
dynamic_update: executed fixation removes its fixation edge; executed part marks removal-complete; node deactivation is deferred until no modeled unexecuted incident fixation remains
primary_e8_contrast: DynamicReal minus five-shuffle mean on Hits@1
inference_note: Sensitivity analysis only. n=5 affected products; minimum possible two-sided exact sign-flip p-value is 0.0625. Effect magnitude and directional consistency are emphasized. Bootstrap intervals are descriptive.
